thread:
jen: Kicking off staged rollout to APAC @15% now. Keeping an eye on edge errors/latency. deploy-bot: roll started -> rollout_id=rr_2026_04_apac_15

deploy-bot: healthcheck: 0/50 failed, 0.0% errors

tom: noted. will watch real-user errors, esp eu-west traffic routing to apac edges.

maya: quick FYI — traffic steering table updated; some users still route through eu caches for 10s.

deploy-bot: 120s update -> 3/50 failed, 6.0% errors (503 gateway) at apac-edge-3 :warning:

ops-sre: saw the spike, correlating with multi-tenant kv cache misses. Not sure if model-change related or edge flake.

jen: @ops-sre any latency tail increase? we care about user p95 and error rate.

ops-sre: p95 up from 280ms to 650ms for affected shards. error pattern looks spikey, not constant.

kai: pushing a quick tail-sample to S3, linking promptset in case of inference regressions: https://intra.redwood/samples/apac-15pct/links (internal)

deploy-bot: 300s update -> 8/50 failed, 16.0% errors. autoscale attempted +2 nodes, no improvement. :x:

tom: given error jump and p95 regression, recommend PAUSE rollout and pin route to previous model. reopening the last stable: `redwoodctl routes pin --route default --version v2.12-stable`

maya: +1 to pause. Also suggest routing fallback to eu-region for affected users while we investigate.

jen: agree. @release-manager — we need approval to pause and pin. change window is still open for another 40m.

release-manager: approve pause & pin. do it, and capture the deploybot logs. we should also file a short release note with the rollback reason. :+1:

deploy-bot: pausing rollout -> rollout_id=rr_2026_04_apac_15 status=PAUSED by jen

deploy-bot: executing pin command -> route default pinned to v2.12-stable (pin_id=pin_8675309)

jen: done and monitoring. ops-sre, can you start a canary test on v2.12-stable to confirm edge behavior returns to baseline?

ops-sre: running canary now against same shards. will report in 5m.

deploy-bot: note: telemetry snapshot saved -> /telemetry/rollouts/rr_2026_04_apac_15/snapshot_1777777777.log

ops-sre: canary results: 0/20 failed, p95=290ms. looks like pin restored baseline.

jen: good. we'll keep the pin and pause for investigation. create a postmortem ticket and add this as 'hold for infra investigation'. tagging @platform and @ml-research for model vs infra root cause.

maya: I'm adding release note: "APAC 15% staged rollout paused and pinned to v2.12-stable due to transient 503 spikes observed on apac-edge. Investigation ongoing."
